::: {#def-population-distribution}
#### Population distribution

The **population distribution** of a variable $X$ is the distribution of $X$
for a unit chosen at random from a population (@def-population):

$$F(t) \eqdef \Pr(X \le t), \quad t \in \reals,$$

where the probability refers to the random choice of the unit.
:::

::: {.remark .notes}
A population may be finite or infinite.
For a finite population of $N$ units, the random choice gives each unit probability $1/N$, so

$$\Pr(X \in A) = \frac{\text{number of units in the population with } X \in A}{N}.$$

An infinite population, such as all the coin flips a coin could ever produce,
is described directly by a distribution.
:::
